title: HustleBox v1.1.0 — Cook Like You Mean It
message:
The food truck just got a real kitchen. No more tap-the-emojis-in-order — now you DRAG ingredients onto a plate, build the order the customer asked for, and slap the bell when it's ready.

NEW GAMEPLAY:
• Drag-and-drop ingredient assembly. Pull each item from the tray and drop it on the plate.
• Tap any item on the plate to remove it if you grabbed wrong.
• The order is now an actual receipt with line items, prices, and a total.
• Hit the SERVE bell when the plate matches the order.
• Plate matching is forgiving — wrong items lower your tip, missing items fail the order.

NEW LOOK:
• The whole shift screen got redressed as a real food truck kitchen — diamond plate aluminum, stainless counter strip with rivets, customer card with patience bar, paper-textured order receipt that prints in with a paper-clip animation, build plate sitting on the counter at a 3D angle.
• Ingredient tray with proper draggable ingredient cards, each showing the price.
• Big red-and-yellow SERVE bell button.
• Bottom nav icons now have a soft amber halo when the tab is active.

GAMEPLAY TWEAKS:
• Orders are now 2–4 items (was 3–5) — cleaner, more focused.
• Timer is more generous since assembly takes longer than tapping.
• Customer card visibly bobs when patience drops below 30%.

No save data wiped. All your Stacks, rep, and rank carry over.
